news.title: Nagpur civic body's panel seeks 50% tax penalty cut for small plots
news.para: Nagpur Municipal Corporation's tax assessment committee has requested a 50% waiver on penalties for property tax arrears. This waiver specifically targets economically weaker sections and small plot owners in the city. The committee expressed concerns about the burden on low-income citizens during the tax recovery process. They urged for verification regarding the issuance of demand bills before issuing warrants.

news.title: Saphalyam flat project in Thrikkakara set for DPR approval
news.para: Thrikkakara municipality is advancing with the Saphalyam flat initiative aimed at supporting economically challenged families. A key decision was finalized recently in Thiruvananthapuram to approve the construction of two towers for 78 families. Issues with land classification had previously delayed the project, but costs have been optimized, with the current estimate at around Rs 10 crore, reflecting adjustments from the original budget.

news.title: Embassy REIT raises ₹1,000 crore through first bank financing at trust level
news.para: Embassy Office Parks REIT has raised ₹1,000 crore through three-year floating-rate NCDs subscribed by a European multinational bank. The transaction is the first bank financing to an Indian REIT at the trust level under the RBI’s new lending framework.

news.title: Pimpri Chinchwad civic body officials to visit housing societies within a week to fix water crunch
news.para: Civic officials held a meeting with housing society representatives regarding the insufficient water supply in Pimpri Chinchwad. Residents are relying on water tankers despite the monsoon season, which typically reduces demand. The president of the housing societies federation reported 36 affected societies to the authorities at the meeting. Concerns were raised about the assurance of a site visit by officials to address these issues.

news.title: Black Rock Hotels plans to scale up to 4,500 keys
news.para: Black Rock Hotels & Resorts, founded by Anshul Bhargava, aims to expand its portfolio to 4,500 hotel rooms by 2031. The company operates seven hotels with about 950 keys. The firm operates on a revenue share model, paying owners 25% of gross revenue. It anticipates launching its first owned property with 241 rooms in Udaipur by March 2027. The company would need at least Rs 1,200 to 1,300 crore in annual revenue before it considers a listing, with Rs 2,000 crore being the ideal. Meanwhile, Black Rock is also exploring international properties in Dubai, Maldives, and Mauritius.

news.title: No more unsold homes, Tamil Nadu housing board to build based on demand
news.para: The Tamil Nadu Housing Board is adopting a demand-led approach for its housing initiatives to cut down on excess unsold inventory. By exploring buyer demand ahead of developing various residential options in targeted areas, the board seeks to tailor its projects more effectively. They've introduced a dedicated digital portal for prospective homeowners to share their preferences.

news.title: Approved properties under 22-A can now be registered: Telangana government
news.para: The state government has rolled out a new initiative allowing property registration under Section 22-A for owners with legitimate layout or building approvals. This effort aims to ease the plight of property owners who have struggled to register despite having proper documentation. To help tackle these issues, district-level committees will be set up to effectively handle land registration challenges.

news.title: Runwal Enterprises raises ₹149 crore from anchor investors ahead of IPO
news.para: Runwal Enterprises has raised about ₹149 crore from anchor investors ahead of its ₹500 crore IPO. The company allotted 48.84 lakh equity shares at ₹305 per share, the upper end of its price band.

news.title: Punjab & Haryana HC clears way for DTCP action against building code violations in housing colonies
news.para: The Punjab and Haryana high court has clarified the authority of the Department of Town and Country Planning over licensed colonies. This ruling primarily addresses jurisdictional conflicts regarding enforcement against unauthorized constructions in DLF 1 to 5. Heightened judicial scrutiny was prompted by complaints of local inaction on building violations.

news.title: Orient Cables raises ₹165.6 crore from anchor investors ahead of IPO
news.para: Orient Cables (India) Ltd has successfully garnered Rs 165.6 crore from anchor investors prior to its initial public offering (IPO). The IPO, valued at Rs 552 crore, is set to commence on September 25 and will conclude on September 29. Share prices are estimated between Rs 258 and Rs 272.

news.title: Sebi approves depository receipts for REITs, InvITs; eases norms for analysts, vault managers
news.para: Sebi's board has given the green light for the issuance of Depository Receipts linked to Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) and Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs) to draw in more foreign investment. The new amendments are designed to enhance unitholder participation in crucial voting processes, as well as provide greater flexibility for sponsors looking to exit.

news.title: Delhi development body orders safety audit of high-rise buildings constructed before 2001
news.para: In response to a spate of building failures resulting in loss of life, the Delhi Development Authority has enforced mandatory structural safety audits for high-rise structures built before 2001. Owners have three months to fulfill this requirement to ensure the buildings' stability. Notably, even structures under 15 meters that experience heavy footfall must undergo assessment.

news.title: Panel formed for policy to regularise residential encroachments on government land in Mumbai, Pune
news.para: The Maharashtra government is taking significant steps to address land encroachment concerns by setting up a 10-member committee focused on formulating a detailed policy. This policy will target residential encroachments on government land in key municipal areas. The committee is responsible for reviewing existing policies and will deliver its recommendations to the Revenue Department in three months, aiming to provide lasting solutions.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh CM launches housing projects worth ₹12,000 crore in Lucknow
news.para: Yogi Adityanath has kicked off the foundation-laying phase for housing projects in Lucknow this Thursday. The extensive Varun Vihar and Naimish Nagar initiatives are projected to stretch across more than 10,680 acres, backed by significant funding. The goal is to ensure well-structured residential options for millions. Moreover, enhancements in transportation links between Lucknow and Naimisharanya are on the horizon to facilitate better access.

news.title: Black Opal Consultants’ ₹55 crore IPO to open on September 29
news.para: Black Opal Consultants has fixed a price band of ₹185-197 per share for its IPO, which will open on September 29 and close on October 1. At the upper end, the issue size is about ₹55.08 crore.

news.title: Anarock acquires 51% stake in DSP Design Associates for about ₹450 crore
news.para: Anarock has acquired a 51% stake in DSP Design Associates, which reported revenue of about ₹450 crore in FY26, at a valuation of around one-time turnover, Anuj Puri, founder and chairman, Anarock Group, told ETRealty. The acquisition has been funded through internal accruals.

news.title: Arbour extends ₹70 crore facility to GSquare Group for Chennai plotted projects
news.para: Arbour has extended a ₹70 crore structured credit facility to GSquare Group to support plotted developments across Chennai’s ECR and Sriperumbudur corridors. The funding includes support for G Square Kings Haven, a 12.47-acre project comprising 235 residential plots.

news.title: NoBroker targets ₹1,250-1,300 crore revenue in FY27, eyes monthly profitability by March
news.para: NoBroker reported revenue of over ₹1,000 crore in FY26, up about 3.6% from ₹965 crore in FY25, while losses declined 25% to ₹290 crore. The company is targeting 25-30% revenue growth in FY27 and expects to achieve monthly profitability by March 2027.

news.title: Australia housing runs out of rescuers as RBA is set to hike rates
news.para: As house prices in Australia decrease, the Reserve Bank of Australia is expected to raise interest rates again. The rise aims to manage ongoing inflation risks stemming from global events and domestic demand. Economists project significant drops in housing prices, suggesting potential economic downturns. Despite falling prices, policymakers are skeptical about the impact on household spending.

news.title: Accepting delayed flat possession does not bar homebuyer from claiming interest: Allahabad HC
news.para: The Allahabad High Court reaffirmed its decision concerning a homeowner's right to interest due to the delayed possession of a flat in Noida. The ruling emerged after Antriksh Developers and Promoters Pvt Ltd contested the court's stance, insisting that restrictions from the National Green Tribunal hindered their construction efforts. However, the court dismissed these claims and instructed the developer to compensate interest for the prolonged delay in possession.
